notes: task #225: NV_Q38_GDN_STEP_VEC4 selects a float4-along-v_glob variant of gdn_decode_split_step_group_lanecol_kernel; unset or 0 launches the shipped 256-thread scalar lanecol kernel byte-for-byte, 1/2/3 launch the vec4 kernel at COLS=32/64/128 (64/128/256 threads). SUBS=8 and KPS=16 are unchanged in every arm so the reduction order is identical and the bit-identity gate (nv-kernels gdn_state_vec4_arm.rs plus the eight-wide real-weight byte-identity suite under the arm) demands exact equality, no tolerance. At B=1 the shipped NV_Q38_BATCH_SOLO_ARMS=1 stack decodes through the m=1 fused trunk which calls the solo (non-group) launcher, so the arm is structurally inert there and the B=1 cells are a second null.
rationale: Rounds 44/46/47 (~/tmp/wf/nullprobe/RESULTS.md, ~/tmp/wf/gdnstate/RESULTS.md, FLOOR-TABLE rounds 46-47): the GDN recurrent state r+w moves 4.53 GB of B=1->B=16 growth at 613-633 GB/s, 43% of the 1475 GB/s DRAM plateau and ~20% of the 3013 GB/s size-matched (3 MB, L2-side) copy ceiling; b.gdn.* is 12.31 ms of the 32.54 ms B=16 step and 58% of the batch growth, worth up to ~4.0 ms. Round 28's null: per-lane launches are graph nodes on forked streams, so launch count is not the cost and every cell here is priced with captured graphs ON. Round 47 ruled out grid starvation, L2 eviction by weight streaming, and scratch traffic. Its uncoalesced-map mechanism, however, describes gdn_decode_split_step_kernel (col=tid/SUBS, sub=tid%SUBS, __shfl_xor reduction) -- the NV_Q38_GDN_STEP_V1 fallback -- not the kernel the group path launches: gdn_decode_split_step_group_lanecol_kernel was born at ba54c78b8 with col=tid%COLS, sub=tid/COLS and a smem cross-sub tree, i.e. design (a) already ships as the default and the 613 GB/s solo cell was measured on the coalesced map. The remaining per-thread lever is (b): float4 along v_glob, 4x fewer load/store instructions on the same coalesced addresses.
